selection_policy: Select one mechanism at a time, reuse an existing state/operator and include a falsification test. Inference-only candidates may run from a fixed checkpoint without training. Trainable architecture changes wait for the exposure frontier and M6 evidence. A test-time repair must preserve the frozen total generation budget and report all EDA response cost.

fast_iteration_policy.quick: 2k training steps with NFE4/refiner400 on the frozen 32-case legalized dev screen
fast_iteration_policy.confirmation: 5k training steps with NFE4/refiner1600 on the same subset and validation manifest
fast_iteration_policy.full_data: one frozen registered finalist plus one same-seed matched control at 20k steps only
forbidden: multiple full-data variants for one mechanism
changing a finalist after observing full-data output
skipping quick or confirmation after a failure

blocking_snapshot.reason: One architecture quick screen is active on cuda:1. Architecture iteration is prioritized over stopping range-seed replication.

candidates.pain_point: fixed computation is wasteful on simple graphs, while the 101-120 block tail fails despite greater structural demand
candidates.minimal_extension: Reuse complexity-scaled sparse slots as a frozen-base adapter, then inject routed slot context into per-block trajectories.
candidates.decision: Reject. The adapter provides more slots to the hardest stratum but worsens it, so additional relational context alone is not the missing mechanism.

candidates.pain_point: a single shared block transform cannot specialize for high-degree and high-pin blocks that dominate structural tail failures
candidates.minimal_extension: Route blocks from normalized b2b/p2b degree into one hidden/4 relational expert behind a zero scale.
candidates.decision: Reject. Specialization creates a narrow cost-only effect and fails the joint primary gate.

candidates.pain_point: the mean physics loss underweights rare structural failures that drive cross-seed V_rel tail instability
candidates.minimal_extension: Add a differentiable top-25% case-level physics penalty with a delayed schedule and no model parameter changes.
candidates.decision: Reject. The objective shifts cost but worsens V_rel, so it does not solve the measured tail instability.

candidates.pain_point: the current hard projector changes an advanced Euler state but does not reinterpolate the trajectory toward the projected final endpoint
candidates.minimal_extension: Add an opt-in source-to-projected-endpoint reinterpolation while retaining the existing per-block model, exact-area decoder and projector.
expected_metrics: legalized cost and V_rel at identical NFE/refiner
candidates.quick_gate: At one matched point from the same source noise, improve both mean cost and V_rel with feasibility 1.0; a negative or mixed result cannot open confirmation.
candidates.confirmation_gate: Confirm the single quick-selected mode on the full frozen 32-case NFE/refiner grid without changing the mode.
candidates.full_gate: Only a confirmed projection-consistent mode may be registered for the full-data candidate gate.

implementation_evidence.smoke_boundary: One-case plumbing only; NFE4 observed cost +0.50% and V_rel unchanged.
implementation_evidence.quick_result: At NFE4/refiner400 final_only improves cost -1.51% and V_rel -2.98% versus post_step; projection_consistent fails the primary point.
implementation_evidence.confirmation_result: At NFE4/refiner1600 final_only regresses cost +3.33% and V_rel +0.59%; reject the family without full data or multiseed.
